description.value: On white ground with thin vertical blue lines resembling lined paper, an abstract yellow form at upper center, an abstract blue form at upper right. Printed in black, vertically, at upper center: attention; the "t" rendered in a fine font, the rest of the text in bold; additional printed text in typewriter-style font at left and within a black square at upper left. Herman Miller company name and logo at lower left.

inscription.inscribed: Printed in black, vertically, upper left: so that people are free to attend to what they care / about. Ironically, though, the freest societies invar- / iably create environments that militate against / attention. Visual pollution is harmful not just be- / cause it is ugly but because it is distractive. And / therefore destructive. Like other pollution, it de- / stroys the balance of nature—in this case, human / nature. A climate loaded with designs clamoring for / your attention is a climate in which you end up / paying attention to nothing. For example,; in white, vertically, within black square at upper left: from / Notes on Attention / by Ralph Caplan. / Herman Miller / Zeeland, Michigan; in black, horizontally, upper left, upside down: Herman Miller tries to pay attention; in black, lower left: herman miller produces office / and health care systems, furniture, / service and information
inscription.signed: Signed in graphite, lower right: 23/100 John Massey

description.value: Poster for International Design Center in Nagoya.  Using color contrast with irregular division of poster.  Four horizontal sections.  Top, imprinted in black: "IdcN".  Inversed pink triangular shape next to "I" with two black circles near base, like beak of bird on white background.  Second: green irregular trapezoid-like shape sloping downward on right side.  Second trapezoid superimpose in purple on left side.  Third: on left side, rectangle divided diagonally into two similiar sections with left part in yellow and right part in red. On right side, a square divided diagonally into two similiar sections with left part in white and right part in blue.  Bottom: divided vertically in two similiar section with left part in olive green and right part in pale green.  Name and credits in black across bottom.

inscription.inscribed: Imprinted in black, lower right corner: logo (profile of bird) "IdcN International Design Center Nagoya Inc." followed by Japanese text.
inscription.signed: Imprinted in black, lower left corner: "Designed by Ikko Tanaka in collaboration with Toppan Printing Co. Ltd. & Takeo Co. Ltd."
